subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these three owner-only conversation tools and the v11 durable conversation-delivery schema as the permanent core contract now?
rationale: This is a broad product, Gateway protocol, plugin SDK, and persisted-data boundary; tests validate mechanics but cannot determine whether this is the intended long-term API or whether its migration cost is acceptable.

options.title: Approve Core Contract
options.body: Accept the API direction, then require live two-peer and released-database upgrade proof on the rebased head before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Reef
options.body: Keep the immediate transport repair plugin-owned and defer generic Gateway tools and persistent core schema until more channels validate the abstraction.

options.title: Pause The Refactor
options.body: Retain explicit `message` targeting and documented local-session semantics while redesigning or closing the broader proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Contract
recommendation.body: Accept the API direction, then require live two-peer and released-database upgrade proof on the rebased head before merge.
